findings.summary: wiki_rename reads the page body and frontmatter outside the single write lock (store.py:422) and uses that stale data inside _write to compute link rewrites and conditionally overwrite the renamed page (store.py:447-449). A concurrent wiki_edit/wiki_update that commits between the outside read and the locked write has its changes silently overwritten, violating spec §8 A8 (no cross-contamination between concurrent mutations). This is the same read-modify-write race pattern that was fixed for wiki_update and wiki_edit (which now re-read the page inside _write) but not applied to wiki_rename. The A8 test only exercises concurrent wiki_create on distinct pages and does not cover concurrent edit+rename on the same page.
